guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul Standard / Fender Telecaster / Danelectro
guitar.evidence: Jimmy Page's 1959 Gibson Les Paul ('Number One') is one of the most iconic guitars in rock history, alongside his well-documented use of a Telecaster (Stairway to Heaven solo) and Danelectro for alternate tunings.

tone.target: bright raw Marshall crunch with tight attack
tone.profile: bright raw Marshall crunch with tight attack
tone.summary: A tight, bright signal chain using a Green OD boost and the UK 45 amp model with a vintage British cabinet to achieve raw, upper-mid focused crunch.
corrections: less gain than modern high gain
